import random

random.seed(7)
lines = []
lines.append("REPORT: daily inventory check")
lines.append("=" * 40)
for i in range(500):
    sku = f"SKU-{1000 + i}"
    qty = random.randint(0, 100)
    status = "OK" if qty > 0 else "OUT"
    lines.append(f"{sku}: qty={qty} status={status}")
lines.append("=" * 40)
lines.append("SUMMARY")
for status in ("OK", "OUT"):
    count = sum(1 for l in lines if f"status={status}" in l)
    lines.append(f"{status}: {count}")
lines.append("FINAL_ANSWER: " + str(sum(1 for l in lines if "status=OK" in l)))
print("\n".join(lines))
